description:
ArtRabbit helps you discover contemporary art exhibitions, events, openings, festivals and art routes wherever you are. Got an hour to spare in Berlin? A free afternoon in London? A long weekend in New York? Open ArtRabbit and see what is happening now, nearby, and worth making time for.

The redesigned ArtRabbit app gives every city a richer cultural dashboard, with themed recommendations for what is new, popular, happening now, opening soon, part of a festival, or best explored on foot. It is a smarter way to plan a gallery day, follow an art week, or stumble into something brilliant between lunch and your next train.

Use ArtRabbit to:
– Discover contemporary art exhibitions and events around the world
– Browse city guides with themed recommendations and curated highlights
– Explore art fairs, gallery weekends, festivals and art weeks in one place
– Follow self-guided walking tours, neighbourhood routes and cultural trails
– See opening times at a glance before you set off
– Find what is open now, nearby, or happening later
– Use maps to navigate exhibitions, venues and route stops
– Save shows you want to see and track the ones you have visited
– Follow artists, galleries and project spaces for future updates
– Share exhibitions and routes with friends
– Book tickets or find membership and publication links for selected events
 – Discover online talks, digital exhibitions and screen-based events

ArtRabbit is editorially managed in key art cities including London, Berlin, New York, and Los Angeles, with more art scenes, partner cities and festival programmes added through our wider community.

Whether you are a regular gallery-goer, a visiting curator, a culturally curious local, or someone who just likes a good wander with a decent coffee stop, ArtRabbit helps you find your way into the art around you.
